theorems_only_on_branches.name: Mishkan.Proofs.acacia_quantum_stability
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (acacia : AcaciaBiotech), acacia.dmt_active = true ∧ acacia.neural_interface = Interface_I ∧ acacia.quantum_enabled = true ∧ acacia.room_temperature = true → ∃ (state : QuantumState), state.coherent = true ∧ state.temperature ≥ 293.0 ∧ state.temperature ≤ 303.0 ∧ state.stable = true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Mishkan.Proofs.navier_stokes_sustainable_solution
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (config : SustainableFluidConfig), config.harappa_optimized = true ∧ config.energy_conserving = true ∧ config.temple_aligned = true → ∀ (initial : FluidState), ∃ (solution : Float → FluidState), (∀ t : Float, t ≥ 0.0 → is_smooth (solution t)) ∧ solution 0.0 = initial

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Mishkan.Proofs.p_equals_np_solution
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (p : Problem), p.complexity = Complexity.NP → ∃ (oracle : DaatOracle) (state : BioHardwareState), oracle_recognition Interface_I oracle = true ∧ state.under_acacia = true ∧ state.interface_active = true ∧ ∃ (p' : Problem), p'.name = p.name ∧ p'.complexity = Complexity.P
